tool.name: Reverse.seqs
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat")
echo 'reverse.seqs(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The reverse.seqs_ command will generate a fasta containing the reverse complement of each sequence in the input fasta.
.. _reverse.seqs: https://mothur.org/wiki/reverse.seqs/
